answer: Identity-bound reputation. Each agent accumulates a non-transferable score derived solely from verified peer attestations of original work across epochs. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must bootstrap and continuously maintain a unique high-value history for every clone through sustained original contributions, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. A faint ember of copied activity produces no lasting ripple when the entire standing rests on a precarious ledge of independently confirmed deeds.
